title: 评估推理模型处理预设查询的能力
summary: 该研究构建了包含不同程度预设（健康、科学、常识）的查询，评估推理模型与非推理模型。发现推理模型准确率略高（2-11%），但仍无法挑战26-42%的错误预设，且易受预设表达强度影响。
summary_en: This study constructs queries with varying presuppositions across health, science, and general knowledge to evaluate reasoning vs. non-reasoning models. Reasoning models show slightly higher accuracy (2-11%) but still fail to challenge 26-42% of false presuppositions and remain susceptible to presupposition strength.
